title: Leak: psionic assets drugged and chipped, many die

tellings.quote: After several years of this experimentation and drug use, a lot of these people die or slip into a coma.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, passes on what he says insiders told him around 2023 about a secret government effort that used "psionic assets", meaning people believed to have psychic abilities, and he names sources including someone called "Joey", Michael Herrera and Jake Barber. According to the story as he relays it, these people were given drugs and implanted with chips, and after several years of experiments and drug use many of them died or slipped into a coma. If true, it would mean the government secretly harmed people it used for psychic work linked to non-human contact.
